Three next contributions are in private stages: Wagner candidate08 passed integration audit; Song’s R4 metadata correction requires a 383-pointer refresh and 12 route/source-group index reconciliations; Zhan’s integration candidate is being corrected for R1/R2 replay, amorphous-feed identity, and asset provenance.
notes: The historical ten-hour local-only trial remains frozen at 8 newly published source contributions; it is not a forecast.
Latest measured two-hour publication interval: 0 new distinct papers in 2.1786 hours. The 20/hour (500/day) target remains unachieved.
Three active source contributions are private and do not count as website papers until independently accepted, integrated, and anonymously verified.
No paid API/cloud processing, external document transfer, or new paper downloads.
previous_notes: Frozen pass set: 5,539 distinct source contents in 5,587 copied files (48 duplicates); main articles and SI are separate screen units, not unique-paper or recipe counts.
Screening pass indicates useful synthesis/preparation evidence plus structural, phase or morphology evidence; it is not an exact sample-pair, source audit or training admission.
Keep every source-reported condition, sample and recipe variant separate. Several papers can contribute independently cited details to one material page.

A small local Qwen3.5:9B benchmark processed two short main articles in 27.6–33.3 s each. It nevertheless missed key source conflicts and sample distinctions. Draft rate is not audited website throughput.

Local extraction drafts are not counted as reviewed website contributions. The Qwen3.5:27B benchmark exposed a conflict-normalization error and missing work-up/statistical details; every candidate still requires an independent source check.
The local model runs offline with cloud features disabled. No paid API or external document upload is authorized.
The local site renderer previously processed 680 records in 11.5 s; source reading, independent review, conflict handling and reader QA—not HTML generation—control end-to-end throughput.
A distinct 27B cross-check caught an omitted reagent but missed the Tirosh 300 K / 230–300 °C conflict and did not inspect figures; model-to-model agreement is not an audit.
Page-wise quote matching rejected two of 16 candidate spans from one Tirosh page; this is a filter test, not a completed paper or audited contribution.

500/day arithmetic: 20.83 completed papers/hour around the clock, or one every 2.88 minutes. Under the earlier 30–60 min per-paper review planning assumption this would require 250–500 reviewer-hours/day (31–63 eight-hour reviewers), before integration overhead; this is a planning bound, not measured labor.

daily_throughput.counting_rule: Count one source paper only after its scoped source reading, independent scientific audit, recipe/sample/figure checks, material-page integration and browser validation pass. Multiple recipe rows from one paper count once. Drafts and screening skips do not count as website papers built.

observed_pipeline.scope_note: Fixed ten-hour local-only trial, including four contributions with pre-trial work. Counts only distinct new source papers deployed and anonymously verified. This arithmetic rate is not a capacity forecast or a claim of continuous unattended work.

daily_throughput.machine_stage_note: The local RTX 5090/Qwen3.5 runs produce drafts quickly, but the 27B cross-check missed a known source conflict. Machine drafts and model agreement are not independent scientific audit or completed website contributions.
